# Medrux

> > Malaysian manufacturer of premium nitrile examination gloves, specializing in latex-free, powder-free medical-grade products with ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications.

Medrux (Yummylooks Sdn Bhd) is a member of the Malaysian Rubber Glove Manufacturers Association (MARGMA) and Malaysia Rubber Council (MRC), producing NBR nitrile gloves for healthcare and industrial markets including MENA regions. The company holds certifications from CE, SFDA, and other international regulatory bodies.

## Key Topics

- Nitrile examination gloves
- Latex-free medical gloves
- Powder-free gloves
- ISO 13485 certification
- ISO 9001 certification
- MARGMA (Malaysian Rubber Glove Manufacturers Association)
- Malaysia Rubber Council (MRC)
- Saudi Food & Drug Authority (SFDA)
- CE certification
- NBR (Nitrile Butadiene Rubber)
- Soft-Fill Technology
- Bulk medical supplies
- MENA healthcare market
- Yummylooks Sdn Bhd

## Nitrile Glove Products

- [MEDRUX® Nitrile Examination Gloves Powder Free](https://medrux.com/disposable-nitrile-examination-gloves): Powder-free nitrile examination gloves with Soft-Fill Technology
- [MEDRUX® Nitrile Aloe Vera Gloves](https://medrux.com/nitrile-aloe-vera-examination-gloves): Nitrile Aloe Vera examination gloves: latex-free, ISO certified
